equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; comparisons are by country, period and host species. Civil unrest and insecurity are geographic access barriers, not tied to social position.

level_alternative.reason: Mobility of cattle herders in South Sudan could be read as an occupational descriptor, but it is not framed as social position.

equity.equity_measurement: Geography (country, region, insecure areas) only; no SPD groups.

notes: Percent changes and containment percentages are arithmetic, so no procedures are recorded. The eradication goal (zero cases) is invoked qualitatively and is not recorded as a referent. Laboratory confirmation at CDC only confirms case status.
view_issues: Figures disagree: Chad 2021 animal infections 843 (Table 1) vs 833 (text, footnote, Table 2); Jan–Jun 2022 animal total 296 (text) vs 299 (Table 2); Cameroon Jan–Jun 2022 dogs 23 (text) vs 26 (Table 2); Chad human change −38% (13 to 8) in Table 1 vs −33% (12 to 8) in Table 2.
